+name: Publish released UMF core to PyPI
+on:
+  workflow_dispatch:
+    inputs:
+      tag:
+        description: Exact existing qualified release tag
+        required: true
+        type: string
+      source_sha:
+        description: Exact commit targeted by the immutable release tag
+        required: true
+        type: string
+      expected_sums_sha256:
+        description: SHA-256 of the public release SHA256SUMS file
+        required: true
+        type: string
+permissions:
+  contents: read
+  actions: read
+concurrency:
+  group: pypi-publish-core-${{ inputs.source_sha || github.run_id }}
+  cancel-in-progress: false
+jobs:
+  verify-release:
+    if: >-
+      (github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && github.ref == format('refs/heads/{0}', github.event.repository.default_branch))
+    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
+    timeout-minutes: 15
+    outputs:
+      version: ${{ steps.source.outputs.version }}
+    steps:
+      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
+        with:
+          ref: ${{ github.workflow_sha }}
+          persist-credentials: false
+      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
+        with:
+          python-version: '3.11'
+      - name: Test the release publisher validator
+        run: python -m unittest scripts.test_publish_core_pypi_release -v
+      - name: Bind exact tag, source and optional backfill pins
+        id: identity
+        env:
+          TARGET_TAG: ${{ inputs.tag }}
+          SOURCE_SHA: ${{ inputs.source_sha }}
+          MANUAL_SUMS_SHA256: ${{ inputs.expected_sums_sha256 }}
+        shell: bash
+        run: |
+          set -euo pipefail
+          [[ "$TARGET_TAG" =~ ^(umf|python)-v(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)$ ]]
+          [[ "$SOURCE_SHA" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{40}$ ]]
+          [[ "$MANUAL_SUMS_SHA256" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{64}$ ]]
+          printf 'tag=%s\nsource_sha=%s\nsums_sha256=%s\n' \
+            "$TARGET_TAG" "$SOURCE_SHA" "$MANUAL_SUMS_SHA256" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
+      - name: Read the immutable public release and tag objects
+        env:
+          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
+          TAG: ${{ steps.identity.outputs.tag }}
+        shell: bash
+        run: |
+          set -euo pipefail
+          mkdir -p incoming
+          gh api "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/releases/tags/$TAG" > incoming/release.json
+          gh api "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/git/ref/tags/$TAG" > incoming/tag-ref.json
+          if [[ "$(jq -r .object.type incoming/tag-ref.json)" == tag ]]; then
+            OBJECT_SHA="$(jq -r .object.sha incoming/tag-ref.json)"
+            gh api "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/git/tags/$OBJECT_SHA" > incoming/tag-object.json
+          fi
+          gh release download "$TAG" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --dir incoming/assets
+      - name: Verify tag source, checksum manifest, pins and package metadata
+        id: source
+        env:
+          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
+          TAG: ${{ steps.identity.outputs.tag }}
+          SOURCE_SHA: ${{ steps.identity.outputs.source_sha }}
+          EXPECTED_SUMS_SHA256: ${{ steps.identity.outputs.sums_sha256 }}
+        shell: bash
+        run: |
+          set -euo pipefail
+          ARGS=(prepare --repository "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --tag "$TAG" --source-sha "$SOURCE_SHA"
+            --expected-sums-sha256 "$EXPECTED_SUMS_SHA256" --distribution umf-core
+            --wheel-prefix "umf_core-" --require-sdist
+            --release-json incoming/release.json --tag-ref-json incoming/tag-ref.json
+            --assets-dir incoming/assets --output-dir dist --receipt dist/source-receipt.json)
+          if [[ -f incoming/tag-object.json ]]; then ARGS+=(--tag-object-json incoming/tag-object.json); fi
+          python scripts/publish_core_pypi_release.py "${ARGS[@]}"
+          printf 'version=%s\n' "$(jq -r .version dist/source-receipt.json)" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
+      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
+        with:
+          name: umf-core-pypi-release-${{ steps.source.outputs.version }}
+          path: dist/*
+          if-no-files-found: error
+          retention-days: 90
+
+  publish:
+    needs: verify-release
+    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
+    timeout-minutes: 20
+    environment: pypi
+    permissions:
+      contents: read
+      actions: read
+      id-token: write
+    steps:
+      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
+        with:
+          ref: ${{ github.workflow_sha }}
+          persist-credentials: false
+      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
+        with:
+          python-version: '3.11'
+      - uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
+        with:
+          name: umf-core-pypi-release-${{ needs.verify-release.outputs.version }}
+          path: dist
+      - name: Refuse PyPI collisions and require exact archive bytes
+        id: preflight
+        run: python scripts/publish_core_pypi_release.py check-pypi --receipt dist/source-receipt.json --dist-dir dist
+      - name: Publish only the verified archives through PyPI OIDC
+        if: steps.preflight.outputs.status == 'absent'
+        run: |
+          mkdir .verified-pypi-packages
+          cp dist/umf_core-*.whl dist/umf_core-*.tar.gz .verified-pypi-packages/
+      - uses: pypa/gh-action-pypi-publish@release/v1
+        id: pypi-upload
+        if: steps.preflight.outputs.status == 'absent'
+        with:
+          packages-dir: .verified-pypi-packages/
+      - name: Verify PyPI-served bytes after publication
+        id: postflight
+        run: python scripts/publish_core_pypi_release.py check-pypi --receipt dist/source-receipt.json --dist-dir dist --wait --timeout 300
+      - name: Record exact PyPI publication result
+        env:
+          UPLOAD_OUTCOME: ${{ steps.pypi-upload.outcome }}
+        run: |
+          python - <<'PY'
+          import json, os
+          from pathlib import Path
+          source = json.loads(Path("dist/source-receipt.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
+          record = {
+              "schema": "pypi-publication-receipt.v1",
+              "status": "passed",
+              "registry": "pypi",
+              "tag": source["tag"],
+              "source_sha": source["source_sha"],
+              "distribution": source["distribution"],
+              "version": source["version"],
+              "files": source["files"],
+              "publication_mode": "oidc_upload" if os.environ["UPLOAD_OUTCOME"] == "success" else "existing_exact_bytes",
+              "oidc_trusted_publisher": os.environ["UPLOAD_OUTCOME"] == "success",
+              "registry_bytes_verified": True,
+          }
+          Path("dist/publication-receipt.json").write_text(json.dumps(record, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
+          PY
+      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
+        with:
+          name: umf-core-pypi-publication-${{ needs.verify-release.outputs.version }}
+          path: dist/*receipt.json
+          if-no-files-found: error
+          retention-days: 365
+
+  installed-consumer:
+    needs: [verify-release, publish]
+    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
+    timeout-minutes: 10
+    steps:
+      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
+        with:
+          python-version: '3.11'
+      - name: Install released UMF core from public PyPI in a clean environment
+        env:
+          VERSION: ${{ needs.verify-release.outputs.version }}
+          PIP_CONFIG_FILE: /dev/null
+        run: |
+          set -euo pipefail
+          python -m venv "$RUNNER_TEMP/pypi-consumer"
+          "$RUNNER_TEMP/pypi-consumer/bin/python" -m pip --isolated install --disable-pip-version-check --no-cache-dir --only-binary=umf-core \
+            --index-url https://pypi.org/simple "umf-core==$VERSION"
+          "$RUNNER_TEMP/pypi-consumer/bin/python" -m pip --isolated check
+          cd "$RUNNER_TEMP"
+          "$RUNNER_TEMP/pypi-consumer/bin/python" -I - <<'PYTHON'
+          import importlib.metadata, json, os, pathlib, sysconfig
+          import umf
+          dist = importlib.metadata.distribution("umf-core")
+          assert dist.version == os.environ["VERSION"]
+          assert pathlib.Path(umf.__file__).is_relative_to(sysconfig.get_path("purelib"))
+          assert dist.read_text("direct_url.json") is None
+          record = {"schema": "pypi-consumer-receipt.v1", "status": "passed",
+                    "index": "https://pypi.org/simple", "umf_core_version": dist.version}
+          pathlib.Path("consumer-receipt.json").write_text(json.dumps(record, indent=2) + "\n")
+          PYTHON
+      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
+        with:
+          name: umf-core-pypi-consumer-${{ needs.verify-release.outputs.version }}
+          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/consumer-receipt.json
+          if-no-files-found: error
+          retention-days: 365

 # Public PyPI publication
 
+## Current required route — 2026-10-26
+
+Owner direction requires `pip install 'arras[truss,umf]'` to resolve wholly from
+public PyPI, with future dependency releases published automatically. This
+repository publishes the existing qualified `umf-core` archives; Truss and Weft
+own their separate packages and workflows. The initial exact-byte backfill is
+core 0.10.0 from SDK tag `umf-v0.5.4`, wheel SHA-256
+`49633924b45a3c8499d4fcc1a24c30d5a8fcb34d974ab019bbda987cb47da0f9`.
+SDK/tag and core package versions are separate identities.
+
+`pypi.yml` now dispatches `publish-pypi.yml` on the default branch when a
+core-bearing SDK or standalone `python-vX.Y.Z` release is published. A completed owned `release*.yml`
+producer is also observed for releases created with GitHub's workflow token.
+The latter route selects exactly one matching published release in that run's
+publication window; missing releases do nothing and ambiguity fails. Unrelated
+component releases are ignored. The former manual rebuild/upload trigger is
+retired so it cannot create competing bytes under an existing package version.
+
+`publish-pypi.yml` requires an exact tag, resolved commit and SHA256SUMS pin,
+validates GitHub digests and the SDK/core release pins, then stages only the
+unchanged core wheel cohort and sdist. Standalone releases bind `tag`, `commit`,
+`distribution`, `version` and the selected filename-to-SHA256 `files` map in
+`release-pins.json`. Every released core archive must appear in the checksum
+cohort. Unsupported raw `linux_x86_64` native wheels are refused before upload;

+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import argparse
+import json
+import re
+from datetime import datetime
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Any
+
+from publish_core_pypi_release import ReleaseError
+
+TAG = re.compile(r"(?:umf|python)-v(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\Z")
+
+
+def core_release(release: dict[str, Any]) -> bool:
+    return (
+        release.get("draft") is False
+        and release.get("prerelease") is False
+        and isinstance(release.get("tag_name"), str)
+        and TAG.fullmatch(release["tag_name"]) is not None
+        and any(
+            isinstance(a, dict)
+            and isinstance(a.get("name"), str)
+            and a["name"].startswith("umf_core-")
+            and a["name"].endswith(".whl")
+            for a in release.get("assets", [])
+        )
+    )
+
+
+def select_release(
+    event_name: str, event: dict[str, Any], releases: list[dict[str, Any]]
+) -> dict[str, str] | None:
+    if event.get("repository", {}).get("full_name") != "DocumentDrivenDX/umf":
+        raise ReleaseError("release event repository differs")
+    if event_name == "release":
+        release = event.get("release")
+        if (
+            event.get("action") != "published"
+            or not isinstance(release, dict)
+            or not core_release(release)
+        ):
+            return None
+        candidates = [release]
+    elif event_name == "workflow_run":
+        run = event.get("workflow_run", {})
+        path = run.get("path", "")
+        if run.get("conclusion") != "success" or not re.fullmatch(

+        ):
+            return None
+        if run.get("head_repository", {}).get(
+            "full_name"
+        ) != "DocumentDrivenDX/umf" or run.get("event") not in {
+            "push",
+            "workflow_dispatch",
+        }:
+            raise ReleaseError("release producer is not an owned release run")
+        start = datetime.fromisoformat(run["created_at"].replace("Z", "+00:00"))
+        end = datetime.fromisoformat(run["updated_at"].replace("Z", "+00:00"))
+        candidates = [
+            r
+            for r in releases
+            if core_release(r)
+            and start
+            <= datetime.fromisoformat(r["published_at"].replace("Z", "+00:00"))

+#!/usr/bin/env python3

+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import argparse
+import hashlib
+import json
+import re
+import sys
+import tarfile
+import time
+import urllib.error
+import urllib.request
+import zipfile
+from email.parser import BytesParser
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Any
+
+SHA = re.compile(r"[0-9a-f]{64}\Z")
+COMMIT = re.compile(r"[0-9a-f]{40}\Z")
+TAG = re.compile(r"(?:umf|python)-v(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\Z")
+
+
+class ReleaseError(ValueError):
+    pass
+
+
+def _require(condition: bool, message: str) -> None:
+    if not condition:
+        raise ReleaseError(message)
+
+
+def _sha(data: bytes) -> str:
+    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()
+
+
+def parse_sums(data: bytes) -> dict[str, str]:
+    try:
+        lines = data.decode("ascii").splitlines()
+    except UnicodeDecodeError as exc:
+        raise ReleaseError("SHA256SUMS is not ASCII") from exc
+    result: dict[str, str] = {}
+    for line in lines:
+        match = re.fullmatch(r"([0-9a-f]{64})  ([A-Za-z0-9_.+-]+)", line)
+        _require(match is not None, "SHA256SUMS has a malformed entry")
+        assert match is not None
+        digest, filename = match.groups()
+        _require(filename not in result, "SHA256SUMS has duplicate filenames")
+        result[filename] = digest
+    _require(bool(result), "SHA256SUMS is empty")
+    return result
+
+
+def _metadata(raw: bytes, distribution: str, version: str) -> None:
+    message = BytesParser().parsebytes(raw)
+    _require(
+        message.get("Name") == distribution,
+        "archive metadata distribution name differs",
+    )
+    _require(message.get("Version") == version, "archive metadata version differs")
+    _require(
+        not any("@" in item for item in message.get_all("Requires-Dist", [])),
+        "archive metadata contains a direct URL dependency",
+    )
+
+
+def validate_archive(path: Path, distribution: str, version: str) -> None:
+    if path.name.endswith(".whl"):
+        platform_tags = path.name[:-4].rsplit("-", 1)[-1].split(".")
+        _require(
+            all(
+                re.fullmatch(
+                    r"(?:any|manylinux_[A-Za-z0-9_]+|manylinux[0-9]+_[A-Za-z0-9_]+|musllinux_[A-Za-z0-9_]+|macosx_[A-Za-z0-9_]+|win32|win_amd64|win_arm64)",
+                    tag,
+                )
+                for tag in platform_tags
+            ),
+            "wheel platform is not accepted by PyPI; qualify genuine portable wheel bytes before publication",
+        )
+    if path.name.endswith(".whl"):
+        try:
+            with zipfile.ZipFile(path) as archive:
+                names = [
+                    name
+                    for name in archive.namelist()
+                    if name.endswith(".dist-info/METADATA")
+                ]
+                _require(
+                    len(names) == 1, "wheel must contain exactly one METADATA file"
+                )
+                _metadata(archive.read(names[0]), distribution, version)
+        except (OSError, zipfile.BadZipFile) as exc:
+            raise ReleaseError("wheel archive is invalid") from exc
+    elif path.name.endswith(".tar.gz"):
+        try:
+            with tarfile.open(path, "r:gz") as archive:
+                members = [
+                    item
+                    for item in archive.getmembers()
+                    if item.isfile() and item.name.endswith("/PKG-INFO")
+                ]
+                _require(
+                    len(members) == 1, "sdist must contain exactly one PKG-INFO file"
+                )
+                stream = archive.extractfile(members[0])
+                _require(stream is not None, "sdist PKG-INFO cannot be read")
+                assert stream is not None
+                _metadata(stream.read(), distribution, version)

+            raise ReleaseError("source archive is invalid") from exc

+        raise ReleaseError("unsupported distribution archive")
+

+def resolve_tag_commit(
+    ref: dict[str, Any], annotated: dict[str, Any] | None, expected_tag: str

+        ref.get("ref") == f"refs/tags/{expected_tag}", "tag reference is malformed"
+    )
+    obj = ref.get("object")

+    kind = obj.get("type")

+        isinstance(sha, str) and COMMIT.fullmatch(sha) is not None,
+        "tag object SHA is invalid",
+    )

+            annotated is None, "lightweight tag unexpectedly has an annotated object"
+        )

+    _require(
+        kind == "tag" and isinstance(annotated, dict), "annotated tag object is missing"
+    )

+        isinstance(target, dict) and target.get("type") == "commit",
+        "tag target is not a commit",
+    )

+        isinstance(target_sha, str) and COMMIT.fullmatch(target_sha) is not None,

+    wheel_prefix: str,

+    )

+    _require(
+        SHA.fullmatch(expected_sums_sha256) is not None, "SHA256SUMS pin is invalid"

+        and release.get("prerelease") is False,

+    )

+        resolve_tag_commit(tag_ref, tag_object, tag) == source_sha,

+    )

+    for item in raw_assets:
+        _require(
+            isinstance(item, dict) and isinstance(item.get("name"), str),

+        )

+            path.is_file() and not path.is_symlink(),

+        )
+        digest = item.get("digest")

+            isinstance(digest, str) and digest == "sha256:" + _sha(path.read_bytes()),
+            f"GitHub asset digest differs for {name}",
+        )

+
+    sums_bytes = read_asset("SHA256SUMS")
+    _require(
+        _sha(sums_bytes) == expected_sums_sha256,
+        "SHA256SUMS differs from its explicit pin",
+    )
+    sums = parse_sums(sums_bytes)
+    pin_bytes = read_asset("release-pins.json")
+    try:
+        pins = json.loads(pin_bytes)
+    except json.JSONDecodeError as exc:
+        raise ReleaseError("release-pins.json is invalid") from exc
+    _require(
+        repository == "DocumentDrivenDX/umf"
+        and distribution == "umf-core"
+        and wheel_prefix == "umf_core-"
+        and require_sdist,
+        "publisher is restricted to the official umf-core wheel and source archive",
+    )
+    if sdk_version is not None:
+        _require(
+            isinstance(pins, dict) and pins.get("sdk") == sdk_version,
+            "release pins do not identify this SDK tag",
+        )
+        version = pins.get("umf_core")
+    else:
+        version = tag.removeprefix("python-v")
+        _require(
+            isinstance(pins, dict)
+            and pins.get("tag") == tag
+            and pins.get("commit") == source_sha
+            and pins.get("distribution") == distribution
+            and pins.get("version") == version,
+            "standalone core release pins differ from tag, source or distribution",
+        )
+    _require(
+        isinstance(version, str)
+        and re.fullmatch(r"[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+", version) is not None,
+        "release pins do not identify a numeric core version",
+    )
+    archives = sorted(
+        name for name in sums if name.startswith(wheel_prefix) and name.endswith(".whl")
+    )
+    _require(
+        1 <= len(archives) <= 32
+        and (sdk_version is None or len(archives) == 1)
+        and (wheel_count is None or len(archives) == wheel_count),
+        "SHA256SUMS wheel inventory differs from the expected cohort",
+    )
+    sdist_prefix = wheel_prefix.rstrip("-")
+    sdists = sorted(
+        name
+        for name in sums
+        if name.startswith(sdist_prefix) and name.endswith(".tar.gz")
+    )
+    _require(
+        len(sdists) == (1 if require_sdist else 0),
+        "SHA256SUMS source archive inventory differs",
+    )
+    selected = archives + sdists
+    published_archives = {
+        name
+        for name in assets
+        if name.startswith(wheel_prefix)

+    )
+    if sdk_version is None:

+        )

+    for name in selected:

+        _require(
+            path.is_file() and not path.is_symlink(),
+            f"release archive {name} is missing or unsafe",
+        )

+        _require(_sha(data) == sums[name], f"SHA256SUMS digest differs for {name}")

+def check_pypi(distribution: str, version: str, expected_files: dict[str, str]) -> str:

+    except (urllib.error.URLError, TimeoutError, json.JSONDecodeError) as exc:
+        raise ReleaseError("PyPI version lookup failed") from exc

+    info = value.get("info")
+    _require(
+        isinstance(info, dict)
+        and info.get("name") == distribution
+        and info.get("version") == version,
+        "PyPI response identifies a different release",
+    )
+    raw = value.get("urls")
+    _require(isinstance(raw, list), "PyPI file inventory is missing")
+    actual: dict[str, str] = {}
+    for item in raw:
+        _require(
+            isinstance(item, dict) and isinstance(item.get("filename"), str),
+            "PyPI file record is malformed",
+        )
+        name = item["filename"]
+        digest = (
+            item.get("digests", {}).get("sha256")
+            if isinstance(item.get("digests"), dict)
+            else None
+        )
+        _require(
+            name not in actual
+            and isinstance(digest, str)
+            and SHA.fullmatch(digest) is not None,
+            "PyPI file inventory contains a duplicate or invalid digest",
+        )
+        actual[name] = digest
+    _require(
+        actual == expected_files,
+        "PyPI version collision: published file inventory or digest differs",
+    )
+    for item in raw:

+        _require(
+            isinstance(file_url, str)
+            and file_url.startswith("https://files.pythonhosted.org/"),
+            "PyPI file URL is outside the public file host",
+        )

+        try:

+        except (urllib.error.URLError, TimeoutError) as exc:
+            raise ReleaseError("PyPI file download failed") from exc

+            )

+        "registry check requires the verified archive directory",
+    )
+    receipt = json.loads(args.receipt.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
+    _require(
